'''startrekccg.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. In 2001 it ran ''Star Trek CCG'' Online, built with DigitalDeck.<ref name="st">[http://startrekccg.decipher.com/ Decipher's Star Trek CCG Online], Decipher (February 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010202031300/http://startrekccg.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
